title: get_filtered_hosts: cyclomatic complexity 19, 31 lines
detail: CCN=19 in a 31-line function indicates highly nested conditional logic. The function applies filters, handles rebuild requests, and manages RUN_ON_REBUILD semantics. Extracting the rebuild-filter logic into a helper would reduce complexity.

title: ReadOnlyDict.__init__ does not call super().__init__
detail: The `ReadOnlyDict` class at line 48 inherits from `UserDict` but does not call `super().__init__()`. `UserDict.__init__` initialises the internal `.data` dict; skipping it may leave the object in an inconsistent state if `ReadOnlyDict` is ever instantiated with initial data.

title: ReadOnlyDict.update signature differs from MutableMapping.update
detail: The `update` method at line 68 removes the variadic `*args` and `**kwargs` accepted by `MutableMapping.update`. Code that calls `obj.update(other_dict)` with keyword arguments on a `ReadOnlyDict` would receive a TypeError at runtime when the object is treated as a MutableMapping. Add `*args, **kwargs` to the signature even if they are rejected.

title: Broad exception catch swallows placement client initialisation errors
detail: The `except Exception` at line 81 catches all errors when testing the placement client and logs at exception level, but the service continues. Non-transient errors (e.g., config mistakes) would be silently ignored, leaving the service running in a degraded state. Propagate fatal configuration errors and only swallow transient network exceptions.

title: Inconsistent return statements at line 666
detail: A function at line 666 has a code path that returns a value and another that returns None implicitly. Make all return paths explicit to avoid caller confusion.
